name: farmgrid-monorepo
description: FarmGrid - Agricultural Resource Coordination Under Scarcity

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: node server/tests/algorithms.test.js && node server/tests/api.test.js && node server/tests/tracking.test.js && node server/tests/e2e_verification.js
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true})"
scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true})"

author: FarmGrid Team
